## 7ed6d6ae68f2

**Domain/ordering limitation reproduced; no target edit made.** Generator SHA-256: `f7a4bd7e7df372742f91685856533ba5ae8cdc35d4e2fb1bc02ba63cc3422860`.

The target's ordinary ordered curriculum is internally consistent: the strict semantic run materialized 12/12 lessons and its declared hook marked all 12 identifiable. However, when the same four-pair lessons were checked with every pair held out in turn under `--require-rotations-identifiable`, 6 of 48 rotations were ambiguous against declared rivals, with 8 hook warnings and 0 scoring errors.

A concrete example is easy-band lesson index 2, seed `4404099775406`, sample index `22`. With pair 2 held out and pairs `[0,1,3]` used as demonstrations, `component_owner_only`, `ties_go_red`, and `ties_go_green` all match every remaining demonstration but predict a different query answer. Their only refuting pair in the full ordered lesson is pair 2 itself; `wall_blind_manhattan` is refuted by all four pairs. The same pattern appears in the retained medium example at seed `79273881201400`, sample index `0`.

This is not reported as a label or production-order defect. It means arbitrary query rotation is unsupported unless the schedule is strengthened or the downstream assembler preserves the advertised ordering/query position. Compact evidence is `checks/audit/7ed6d6ae68f2/rotation-finding.json`; the full source-bound report is `checks/audit/7ed6d6ae68f2/required-rotations/checks/7ed6d6ae68f2_after_semantic_gate.json`.

triage.reason: Accepted as source-bound reviewer-reported findings. 7ed6d6ae68f2: production-order lessons identifiable; six of 48 arbitrary query rotations ambiguous, not an authority-label failure. 914cf1c42d85: placement retries can omit the declared size-four body while self_check accepts the narrower scene; concrete cardinality/contract repair lead. No audited source was changed by this intake.
